correctness.rationale: Reconstructed necessity by the hub cut and the impossibility of the first force into an unseeded cycle or either of two unseeded arms; sufficiency by filling the white cycle arc, seeded arm suffixes and at most one remaining arm in that order. Counting gives z times the cycle factor times the sum of seed-all and omit-one products. Substitution gives z^t F_c(z)(z^2+tz+t). For c>=5 the normalized cycle factor has coefficients 1,3/2,2, impossible for a product of factors 1+x_i z with all x_i positive since (3/2)^2 would exceed 2*2. The quadratic discriminant is t(t-4), with a double root at -2 at t=4; the c=3,4 factors split. The replacement credits the prior structural input and retains a complete proof of the root statement.
